text:
devon: quick heads-up — planning a stress-probe for Nov 22 launch + Black Friday window. Need GPU-hours estimate, canary plan, pre-warm and fallback. cc @kai @maria

kai: timeline? BF is Nov 24 right?

devon: yes. probe window Nov 18-23. Goal: simulate 1.5x expected peak and a 10x short microburst (60s).

maria: baseline snapshot: prod fleet (us-west1 + eu-west1) ~= 320 A100-equivalent GPUs. Current forecasted peak ~4k req/s gen, avg seq len 256. Rough estimate: ~18k GPU-hours across the peak weekend without optimizations.

ajay: can we hit that down with more aggressive batching + KV prefix caching? Redwood Optimize recommends ~25% reduction for similar conversation workloads.

kai: propose canary in us-west1 with 16 GPUs, health gates: if p95 latency < 1800ms and error rate < 0.3% after 15m, expand to 64 GPUs. Rollback on 2 consecutive gate failures.

devon: cost guardrails: keep incremental reserve spend under $18k/day. What are we assuming for GPU-hour pricing?

maria: use $3.5/GPU-hour for preemptible/spot-equivalent, $10/GPU-hour for reserved. We'll plan a mixed reservation: ~60% spot, 40% reserved for critical routes.

lexi: networking note — eu-west1 inter-region egress gets pricey under cross-region fallbacks. Prefer local model fallbacks (gpt-medium quant) for EU traffic to avoid egress spikes.

ajay: here's a quick autoscale/fallback snippet to include in the canary bundle:

```yaml
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 64
  cpu_threshold: 65
  queue_depth_threshold: 200
  burst_window_s: 60
  fallback_policy:
    - model: gpt-medium-quant
      max_replicas: 32
```

kai: I'll run the synthetic fanout sim using sim-tool with target rps=6k and a 60s spike. Will post the script in #eng-infra-playbooks.

devon: schedule the run for 04:00 UTC tomorrow (low real-traffic). ops-bot — can you create the job?

ops-bot: scheduled job sim-run-1865007890 for 2024-11-18T04:00:00Z, tagged with run_id=sim-1865007890. Notifications set to #eng-infra and on-call.

maria: action items (short): 1) reserve 80 GPUs in us-west1 (temp) 2) assemble canary config 3) run synthetic sim 4) verify billing/alert thresholds (cost > $15k/day)

devon: owners: @kai -> canary + sim, @maria -> capacity reservations, @ajay -> optimize configs (batching/KV), @lexi -> fallback model artifacts. Please update this thread with ✔️/✖️ by EOD.

kai: ACK :thumbsup: I'll post the sim script and expected logs.

ajay: will validate KV cache behavior in staging and push a small quantization profile test.

lexi: prepping quantized gpt-medium-1 artifacts and small model-size benchmarks. Should have artifacts by morning.

devon: thanks team — after the sim we'll reconvene with numbers: projected GPU-hours, expected cost delta with optimizations, canary gate timings, and rollback triggers.

kai: one more: add a p99 SLA alert to the canary route so SRE sees regressions immediately.

maria: added billing alert: threshold set at $14k/day for incremental spend; ops-bot will notify if breached.

ops-bot: billing alert created: threshold=14000, channels=[#eng-infra, finance-alerts].

devon: perfect. Closing planning thread — move updates into this thread as we get sim results.
